description: This file contains Russian localization strings for the Select2 jQuery plugin, specifically version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines translation functions for various UI messages used within the plugin.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns a localized message indicating failure to load search results.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Generates a message indicating the user's input exceeds the maximum allowed length, handling pluralization.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Generates a message prompting the user to input more characters, based on the minimum requirement.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns a localized message indicating loading more data.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Informs the user that they've reached the maximum number of selectable items, handling pluralization.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns a message indicating no search results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a search is in progress.
